# Footer Section Module
---

```{r}
#| label: footer-html
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

cat('

---

<div class="footer-section">

### Download Options

<div class="download-buttons">

<a href="jpbsQuartoCV.pdf" class="download-btn pdf"><i class="fas fa-file-pdf"></i> Download PDF CV</a>
<a href="papers.html" class="download-btn papers"><i class="fas fa-file-alt"></i> View Working Papers</a>

</div>

<div class="last-updated">
*Last Updated: ', format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y"), '*
</div>

</div>
')
```
